_comment: SYNTHETIC fixture for the topic-paper tests (fictional). First chat about a community garden plot.

messages.message: I got plot 7 at the Maple Street community garden. It's ten feet by ten feet.
Congrats on plot 7. A ten by ten plot fits about four rows if you leave paths.
I want to grow peppers, zucchini and lettuce. The garden opens for planting on May 1st.
Peppers and zucchini like full sun, lettuce tolerates some shade, so put the lettuce on the north edge.
Good idea. I still need to buy a hose and pay the forty dollar plot fee by Friday.
Noted: buy a hose, and pay the forty dollar plot fee by Friday.
